items.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
items.body: A can complete a piece of work in 12 days, and B can complete it in 18 days. If they work on alternate days with A starting on the first day, in how many days will the work be completed?

metadata.solutionShort: LCM(12, 18) = 36 units. A does 3 u/day, B does 2 u/day. In 2 days, 5 units done. In 14 days, 35 units done. Remaining 1 unit completed by A in 1/3 day. Total: 14 1/3 days.

items.subject: Logical Reasoning
items.body: Pointing to a photograph of a boy, Suresh said, "He is the son of the only son of my mother." How is Suresh related to that boy?

metadata.solutionShort: Mother’s only son = Suresh himself. The boy is the son of Suresh -> Suresh is the Father.
